name: Microsoft 365 Mail
description: Search, read, draft, send, and manage the signed-in user's Outlook mail securely.
description_zh: 安全搜索、读取、起草、发送和管理当前登录用户的 Outlook 邮件。
description_en: Search, read, draft, send, and manage the signed-in user's Outlook mail securely.
examples_zh: 查找本周关于项目验收的邮件
读取刚才搜索结果中的第一封邮件
起草一封项目进展邮件，确认后发送
examples_en: Find messages about project acceptance from this week
Read the first message from the previous search results
Draft a project update email and send it after confirmation
